name: competitor-hunt
description: Competitor Hunter: judge one competitor piece (YouTube video or Instagram post) for the creator in creator_profile. Lane, audience fit, hook, proof, replicable, sponsored, news-pegged.

topic_lane.instructions: What is the main subject of the piece, judged from `title` first and `description` second?

criteria.claude_code: Names Claude, Claude Code, Anthropic, a Claude model, Claude skills, plugins, or MCP servers as the main subject.
criteria.agent_systems: About building or running AI agents, agent teams, a second brain, or an AI operating system, without Claude being the named main subject.
criteria.business_automation: About automating business work or earning money with AI services: client work, lead generation, agencies, SaaS, a dollar or revenue outcome.
criteria.other_ai_tools: About an AI tool or model that is not Claude: ChatGPT, Gemini, n8n, image or video generators, coding tools from other vendors.
criteria.off_niche: Not about AI or automation: lifestyle, personal vlog, giveaway, motivation with no tool or workflow named.

icp_fit.instructions: How directly does the piece (`title`, `description`) serve the audience named in `creator_profile`?
criteria: Off target: the topic gives a business owner or an AI beginner nothing to use.
Adjacent: an AI topic aimed at developers or hobbyists, with no business use stated.
On target: shows a tool or workflow a business owner or beginner could apply, stated in the title or description.
Bullseye: names a business outcome (time saved, money made, tasks removed) and the tool or workflow that produces it.

hook_type.instructions: Which hook pattern opens `title`? When two patterns appear, pick the one that appears first in `title`.

criteria.contradiction: Denies a common belief or tells the viewer to stop doing something: stop, don't, is dead, is lying, wrong, nobody tells you.
criteria.number_specific: Leads with a specific number, count, or dollar amount as the draw: 84 skills, $1M, 10x, 3 steps, 7 tools.
criteria.newsjack: Leads with a product, model, or feature presented as new: just dropped, just released, new, a version number.
criteria.outcome_build: Leads with something the creator built or a result they got: I built, how I, my system, I replaced.
criteria.how_to: Leads with an instruction or a tutorial promise: how to, full guide, course, tutorial, setup, step by step.

proof.instructions: How much visible proof does the piece promise in `title` and `description`?
criteria: Opinion or news only: nothing is built or shown.
Shows a tool or a setup on screen.
Builds something from start to finish on screen.
Shows a measured result: revenue, hours saved, a count, or a before and after.

replicable.instructions: Could the creator in `creator_profile` publish their own version of this piece using the tools named in `title` or `description`, without needing the original creator's personal story, private data, or a sponsor's product?

sponsored.instructions: Is the whole piece a paid promotion for one named company's product (a dedicated sponsored video or brand deal), as stated in `title` or `description`, rather than the creator's own topic with at most a short sponsor mention?

newsjack.instructions: Is the piece pegged to a product release or announcement that was new when it was posted (a new model, a new feature, a version number, 'just dropped'), judged from `title` and `description`?
